environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4). The NLB performs TCP passthrough only — no request inspection. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.11 and gunicorn. No additional middleware or proxy filtering is configured between the NLB and the application.
